input.sha256_scope: original input file bytes, before gzip decompression

tie_policy.gene_ranks: exact ranking-score ties use ascending lexical gene ID
tie_policy.donor_value_ties: equal effects are sorted by original input row index
tie_policy.within_cardinality_extrema: first attaining two-family candidate in deterministic traversal order
tie_policy.across_cardinality_extrema: equal extended paired-t scores keep the fewest deletions

topk_audit.target: unordered paired-t top-K set; lexical gene-ID ties
topk_audit.arithmetic: exact moments/comparisons of input binary64 values
